steps.js: const wait = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)), S = () => window.luminaState(); const tap = async (key, code) => { window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key, code, bubbles: true })); await wait(60); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', { key, code, bubbles: true })); await wait(40); }; document.querySelector('[data-lumina=tile]').click(); await wait(120); const id = S().cur; if (S().marks[id] !== 'keep') await tap('p', 'KeyP'); else await tap('ArrowRight', 'ArrowRight'); await tap('ArrowLeft', 'ArrowLeft'); const back = S().cur; await tap('p', 'KeyP'); return back === id && S().marks[id] === 'keep' && S().cur !== id;
